fusions.name: Landslide
fusions.desc: Drops a mass of packed strands on the target, dealing 30 earth damage that ignores resistance and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Clod Toss
fusions.desc: Lobs a knot of earth-caked strands at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 earth damage.

fusions.name: Backfilled Wound
fusions.desc: Packs your strands over your wounds, restoring 18 health to you, with a 10% chance to critically heal.

fusions.name: Turned Sod
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
